desc: The Ridgeline Scout combines all the best features of the Ridgeline into a new, compact scout rifle. Additional features include a Black-Nitride coated action, 0-MOA optic rail, barricade stop, 10-rd AICS drop-box magazine, and a flat-shoe Trigger Tech trigger, all in a tan and black carbon fiber composite Sporter stock. The 16" barrel with a removable 3-prong flash hider makes the Ridgeline Scout an ideal suppressor host.
